{
  "project_id": "P-SLE-ConnectivityAgMarketInfra",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Macroeconomic pressures, soaring inflation, and fiscal constraints in Sierra Leone could inflate project construction costs and strain government counterpart funding.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate adequate price and physical contingencies into procurement contracts and closely monitor economic indices during implementation.",
      "evidence": "I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT, Country Context: macroeconomic environment, which is characterized by intensified fiscal pressures, soaring inflation driven by global supply shocks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "High vulnerability to severe natural hazards such as river flooding, landslides, and extreme heat risks damaging transport and market infrastructure and causing connectivity disruptions.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply climate-resilient engineering design standards including elevated bridge decks, right-sized culverts, scour protection, and heat-resistant paving materials.",
      "evidence": "I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT, Country Context: The key climate and natural hazards present in Sierra Leone are flooding, landslides, extreme heat, and wildfire."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Institutional fragmentation and overlapping mandates among transport agencies may result in poor coordination and project implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Operate a three-layered institutional structure led by a National Project Steering Committee and unified PCIU to streamline inter-agency coordination.",
      "evidence": "I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT, Institutional Context: institutional framework for transport sector management in Sierra Leone is fragmented and lacks systematic coordination among the multiple agencies"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Insufficient revenue collection by the Road Maintenance Fund Administration could lead to inadequate long-term maintenance of newly built roads and bridges.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Support the development of a national transport strategy to reform road maintenance financing and deploy digital asset management systems (BMS/RAMS).",
      "evidence": "I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT, Institutional Context: The funding to road investment and maintenance is also insufficient. In 2020, the RMFA collected... a small fraction"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Substantial financial management risks due to MTA's limited experience with World Bank fiduciary procedures and internal control weaknesses.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated FM unit in PCIU, recruit a qualified FM Specialist and Internal Auditor, adopt an FM Manual, and open a segregated account.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 7: Financial Management Assessment: overall FM risks were rated as ‘High’ before mitigation... Insufficient experience of MTA with the World Bank’s FM procedures"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Absence of an established procurement unit and experienced procurement staff in the PCIU at entry could delay tender processes and contract awards.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified procurement staff prior to project effectiveness, adopt STEP tracking, and implement a detailed Project Procurement Strategy for Development.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 6: Procurement Management Assessment: The PCIU does not have a procurement unit currently and it will be established and staffed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Fiscal stress may prevent the Government of Sierra Leone from fulfilling its committed funding share for ongoing SCADeP bridge contracts.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Allocate US$4 million under project Subcomponent 2(b) to cover the bridge funding gap after full utilization of SCADeP resources.",
      "evidence": "Component 2: Resilient Rural Bridges and Link Roads: leaves a funding gap of about US$7.1 million... government has committed to cover the remaining US$3.1 million"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Prolonged rainy seasons and rising river water levels can suspend civil works and delay bridge and link road construction.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Schedule foundation and sub-structure works during the dry season and utilize incremental launching construction methods for bridge superstructures.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 5: Climate Change Mitigation: In 2023, Sierra Leone experienced a prolonged rainy season... leading to a rise in water levels... civil works... were suspended"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Unanticipated subsurface geotechnical conditions at bridge river crossings could require foundation design modifications and cause cost overruns.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct mandatory post-award geotechnical site investigations to verify pile depths and engage independent supervision consultants for design reviews.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 2: Component 2: Additional geotechnical investigation is proposed for the bridges after the contract award to establish, particularly, the foundation or pile depth."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Vulnerability to fraud, corruption, and collusion in contracting processes could impair project value for money and resource allocation.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce mandatory STEP use, check beneficial ownership, verify bidder bank guarantees, conduct internal/external audits, and publish contract awards publicly.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 6: Table 6.1: Fraud and corruption risks (including collusion and outside interference) in contracting process"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Risks of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH) during civil works construction and urban public transit operations.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt and implement an SEA/SH Action Plan, enforce worker codes of conduct, install CCTV cameras on public buses, and establish reporting hotlines.",
      "evidence": "DATASHEET, Legal Covenants: (iv) the Sexual Exploitation and Abuse/Sexual Harassment Action Plan consistent with the ESCP and relevant ESSs."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delays in adopting or disclosing required Environmental and Social standards instruments (ESIA, ESMP, RAP, LMP) could hold up project disbursements and works.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize Project Preparation Advance (PPA) funding to complete, consult on, and disclose all required E&S instruments within mandated post-effectiveness deadlines.",
      "evidence": "DATASHEET, Legal Covenants: adopt and disclose the updated Environmental and Social Management Plan for Components 1 and 3; (ii) the Environmental and Social Impact Assessment"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Lack of a synchronized digital road safety database and manual crash reporting hamper effective road safety monitoring and targeted interventions.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop national road safety guidelines, build a synchronized digital road safety database, and install physical safety features on high-risk transit corridors.",
      "evidence": "I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT, Transport Connectivity: There is no systematic database on road safety, and Sierra Leone Road Safety Authority (SLRSA) and the police department collect road incidents manually"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Lack of all-season market infrastructure and processing facilities leads to severe post-harvest commodity losses for rural agricultural producers.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Construct and upgrade aggregation centers, storage facilities, and solar-powered cold storage in bridge catchment areas.",
      "evidence": "I. STRATEGIC CONTEXT, Agricultural Market Access: lack of market infrastructure pushes farmers to face higher post-harvest losses (20–30 percent of farm produce)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Capital constraints and operational informality among private bus operators could hinder participation in the urban public transport fleet renewal program.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Structure a lease-operate-own concession scheme to lower upfront capital barriers and formalize informal operator associations into corporate entities.",
      "evidence": "Component 1: Resilient Urban Transport: Scheme mobilizes private capital through the concession contract, while resolving the financial constraints of the private sector in fleet capital investment."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Limited smartphone ownership and digital literacy among rural women could restrict their access to the upgraded Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS).",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Partner with local women's organizations and community groups to offer offline market information channels alongside digital literacy training.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 2: Component 3: evidence shows that rural women and farmers often have limited access to mobile phones based on factors such as literacy rates, income levels"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Weak technical and administrative capacity in local councils could lead to inadequate operation and maintenance of constructed agricultural market facilities.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted capacity building to local councils on revenue collection systems, asset management, and fund allocation for market maintenance.",
      "evidence": "ANNEX 2: Component 3: Ownership structure: local councils are responsible for the establishment and administration of market centers... councils will establish a revenue collection system"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Inadequate financial management software and unaligned accounting systems in PCIU could cause delays in financial reporting and audit compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure suitable accounting software within 90 days of effectiveness and conduct comprehensive FM and disbursement training for project staff.",
      "evidence": "DATASHEET, Legal Covenants: identified and procured appropriate software for use in Project accounting; and (ii) carried out a training in financial management"
    }
  ]
}
